fact: On 29 November 2024 the Justice Minister replied that the NPA obtained 39 convictions in 2022-23 and 55 in 2023-24 for cyber-crimes and that 37 cases with 88 charges under the Cyber Crimes Act were on court rolls.
title: Question NW1541 to the Minister of Justice and Constitutional Development
publisher: Parliamentary Monitoring Group (Parliament of South Africa)
